name: After § 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on a united response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
part_text: 4e. Expresses serious concern regarding the European Union’s initiative to establish a drone surveillance and defence system (‘drone wall’), emphasising that such a focus risks diverting critical financial and political resources towards an excessively militarised and confrontational posture predominantly concentrated on the EU’s eastern border; underlines that an excessive reliance on militarisation may lead to the escalation of conflicts, jeopardise the protection of fundamental rights, and contribute to the fragmentation of the Union’s cohesive strategic vision;
